1.en_consolidated_definition:
To exhaust oneself.

Alternatively:

1. To become completely spent or depleted.
2. (En el contexto de Puerto Rico) To experience physical or mental exhaustion due to the demands of working in the fields during harvest season (e.g., "agotarse" en la cosecha).
